name: godot-fabric

scripts.test:recovery: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p '*_test.py' && node --test tests/recovery.test.mjs
scripts.test:typography: npm run bundle && node --test tests/typography-contract.test.mjs tests/typography-native.test.mjs tests/line-height-native.test.mjs
scripts.test:contracts: npm run bundle && npm run type-check && npm run test:parity && node --test tests/nativewind-contract.test.mjs tests/svg-contract.test.mjs tests/typography-contract.test.mjs tests/publication-scan.test.mjs tests/examples.test.mjs tests/control-contracts.test.mjs && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p "*_test.py"
scripts.test:parity: node scripts/parity-inventory.mjs --check && node --test tests/parity-inventory.test.mjs tests/parity-protocol.test.mjs tests/reference-cleanup.test.mjs

description: An experimental React renderer for Godot, powered by React Native Fabric and Hermes
